mode: with Gemini: LLM features on (compression, graph extraction, consolidation)
door: memory_recall(query, limit=10) through POST /agentmemory/mcp/call, the route the MCP stdio shim forwards to; the tool's own text
results: limit 10 (its default), format full (its default), no relevance floor, no cut
model: gemini-3-flash-preview (Google): compresses observations, extracts the knowledge graph, runs consolidation
embeddings: gemini-embedding-001, 768 dimensions (Google, the one Gemini embedder it ships)
storage: local scratch data directory on the iii engine (format not stated)
not_default: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3-flash-preview and EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=gemini (the Gemini setup); AGENTMEMORY_AUTO_COMPRESS=true, GRAPH_EXTRACTION_ENABLED=true, CONSOLIDATION_ENABLED=true (the three flags /config/flags lists as needing an LLM); the import also runs /graph/build and /consolidate-pipeline
